name: Palo Alto Firewall - Security Analytics Searches
description: Candidates for scheduled searches to alert for security relevant events.

children.name: DNS Traffic - Multi-Dimensional Outlier (Outbound)

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = *paloaltonetworks*  TRAFFIC dns
//| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action,32 as bytes, 33 as bytes_sent, 34 as bytes_recv, 35 as Packets, 36 as StartTime, 37 as ElapsedTime, 38 as Category, 39 as f4, 40 as seqNum, 41 as ActionFlags, 42 as src_Country, 43 as dest_country, 44 as pkts_sent, 45 as pkts_received, 46 as session_end_reason, 47 as Device_Group_Hierarchy , 48 as vsys_Name, 49 as DeviceName, 50 as action_source, 51 as Source_VM_UUID, 52 as Destination_VM_UUID, 53 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 54 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 55 as Parent_Session_ID, 56 as parent_start_time, 57 as Tunnel, 58 as SCTP_Association_ID, 59 as SCTP_Chunks, 60 as SCTP_Chunks_Sent, 61 as SCTP_Chunks_Received
| where type="TRAFFIC"
| where app = "dns"
| timeslice 5m
| isPrivateIP(src_ip) as private_src_ip
| where private_src_ip
| isPublicIP(dest_ip) as public_dest_ip
| where public_dest_ip
| sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_sent by _timeslice, src_ip
| outlier bytes_sent by src_ip
| fields _timeslice,src_ip, bytes_sent, bytes_sent_violation
| where bytes_sent_violation > 0

children.description: Alerts when a single src_ip sends an abnormally high volume of data outbound.

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = *paloaltonetworks*  TRAFFIC dns {{src_ip}}
//| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action,32 as bytes, 33 as bytes_sent, 34 as bytes_recv, 35 as Packets, 36 as StartTime, 37 as ElapsedTime, 38 as Category, 39 as f4, 40 as seqNum, 41 as ActionFlags, 42 as src_Country, 43 as dest_country, 44 as pkts_sent, 45 as pkts_received, 46 as session_end_reason, 47 as Device_Group_Hierarchy , 48 as vsys_Name, 49 as DeviceName, 50 as action_source, 51 as Source_VM_UUID, 52 as Destination_VM_UUID, 53 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 54 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 55 as Parent_Session_ID, 56 as parent_start_time, 57 as Tunnel, 58 as SCTP_Association_ID, 59 as SCTP_Chunks, 60 as SCTP_Chunks_Sent, 61 as SCTP_Chunks_Received
| where type="TRAFFIC"
| where app = "dns"
| timeslice 5m
| isPrivateIP(src_ip) as private_src_ip
| where private_src_ip
| isPublicIP(dest_ip) as public_dest_ip
| where public_dest_ip
| where src_ip matches "{{src_ip}}"
| sum(bytes_sent) as bytes_sent by _timeslice
| outlier bytes_sent

_sourceCategory = *paloaltonetworks* 
//| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action,32 as bytes, 33 as bytes_sent, 34 as bytes_recv, 35 as Packets, 36 as StartTime, 37 as ElapsedTime, 38 as Category, 39 as f4, 40 as seqNum, 41 as ActionFlags, 42 as src_Country, 43 as dest_country, 44 as pkts_sent, 45 as pkts_received, 46 as session_end_reason, 47 as Device_Group_Hierarchy , 48 as vsys_Name, 49 as DeviceName, 50 as action_source, 51 as Source_VM_UUID, 52 as Destination_VM_UUID, 53 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 54 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 55 as Parent_Session_ID, 56 as parent_start_time, 57 as Tunnel, 58 as SCTP_Association_ID, 59 as SCTP_Chunks, 60 as SCTP_Chunks_Sent, 61 as SCTP_Chunks_Received
| count by src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port
| concat(src_ip,"_",dest_ip) as port_scan_ip_combo
| sum(_count) as _count by port_scan_ip_combo, dest_port
| sort by port_scan_ip_combo     
| 1 as rownum
| total rownum by port_scan_ip_combo
| where _total > 20  
| tolong(0) as _messagetime 
| sort _count
| transactionize port_scan_ip_combo (merge port_scan_ip_combo takefirst,dest_port,_count, _total join with "\n")
| fields - _messagetime
| sort by _total

_sourceCategory = *paloaltonetworks* 
//| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action,32 as bytes, 33 as bytes_sent, 34 as bytes_recv, 35 as Packets, 36 as StartTime, 37 as ElapsedTime, 38 as Category, 39 as f4, 40 as seqNum, 41 as ActionFlags, 42 as src_Country, 43 as dest_country, 44 as pkts_sent, 45 as pkts_received, 46 as session_end_reason, 47 as Device_Group_Hierarchy , 48 as vsys_Name, 49 as DeviceName, 50 as action_source, 51 as Source_VM_UUID, 52 as Destination_VM_UUID, 53 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 54 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 55 as Parent_Session_ID, 56 as parent_start_time, 57 as Tunnel, 58 as SCTP_Association_ID, 59 as SCTP_Chunks, 60 as SCTP_Chunks_Sent, 61 as SCTP_Chunks_Received
| count by src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port
| where !(dest_port matches "0")
| concat(src_ip,"_",dest_port) as port_scan_port_combo

| sort by port_scan_port_combo

| where _total > 10  
| tolong(0) as _messagetime

| transactionize port_scan_port_combo (merge port_scan_port_combo takefirst,dest_ip,_count, _total join with "\n")
| fields - _messagetime 
| sort by _total

_sourceCategory = *paloaltonetworks*
//| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action,32 as bytes, 33 as bytes_sent, 34 as bytes_recv, 35 as Packets, 36 as StartTime, 37 as ElapsedTime, 38 as Category, 39 as f4, 40 as seqNum, 41 as ActionFlags, 42 as src_Country, 43 as dest_country, 44 as pkts_sent, 45 as pkts_received, 46 as session_end_reason, 47 as Device_Group_Hierarchy , 48 as vsys_Name, 49 as DeviceName, 50 as action_source, 51 as Source_VM_UUID, 52 as Destination_VM_UUID, 53 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 54 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 55 as Parent_Session_ID, 56 as parent_start_time, 57 as Tunnel, 58 as SCTP_Association_ID, 59 as SCTP_Chunks, 60 as SCTP_Chunks_Sent, 61 as SCTP_Chunks_Received
| where !isBlank(src_ip) and src_ip <> "-"
| isPublicIP(src_ip) as public_src_ip
| where public_src_ip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name as country_name, region, city from geo://location on ip = src_ip
| where !isNull(country_name)
| where (country_name matches "Belarus" or country_name matches "Burma" or country_name matches "*Ivoire*" or country_name matches "Cuba" or country_name matches "Congo" or country_name matches "Iran" or country_name matches "Iraq" or country_name matches "Liberia" or country_name matches "Sudan" or country_name matches "Syria" or country_name matches "Zimbabwe" or country_name matches "Korea")
| if(isBlank(dest_user), "n/a", dest_user) as dest_user
| count by country_name, src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, action
